rule.name: RandomInTest
rule.message: This test draws unseeded random values, so it can pass on one run and fail on the next. Use fixed values, or a seeded generator the subject takes: new Random(42), or Collections.shuffle(list, random) with that generator. Compare a fixed UUID (UUID.fromString(...)), not UUID.randomUUID().

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $expecting := ('assertEquals', 'assertSame', 'assertArrayEquals', 'assertIterableEquals', 'isEqualTo', 'isSameAs', 'hasToString'), $faked := function($n, $types) { $n/ancestor::CompilationUnit//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'mockStatic'] /ArgumentList/ClassLiteral/ClassType/@SimpleName = $types } return ( //ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.util.Random') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.util.SplittableRandom')] [ArgumentList/@Size = 0 or ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.System#nanoTime()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.System#currentTimeMillis()')]] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Math#random()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.StrictMath#random()')] [not($faked(., ('Math', 'StrictMath')))] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom#current()')] [not($faked(., 'ThreadLocalRandom'))] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Collections#shuffle(java.util.List)')] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.UUID#randomUUID()')] [ancestor-or-self::*[not(parent::MethodCall and not(preceding-sibling::*))][1] /parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = $expecting]] [not($faked(., 'UUID'))] )
